quickQuestions: How do I find a market near me?
What markets are open on Saturday?

rules.response: 👋 Hello! Welcome to FreshFind! I'm here to help you discover local farmers' markets and seasonal produce. What would you like to know?

🌿 A farmers' market is a community marketplace where local farmers, growers, and food producers sell their fresh products directly to consumers. Benefits include:

✓ Fresher produce (often picked the same morning)
✓ Supporting local farmers and growers
✓ Seasonal and often organic options
✓ Unique varieties you won't find in supermarkets
✓ Community connection and atmosphere

FreshFind helps you discover the best markets near you!

📍 Finding a market near you is easy with FreshFind!

1️⃣ Use the **Search bar** on the home page to search by area or neighbourhood
2️⃣ Visit the **Market Directory** and filter by your area
3️⃣ Click **'Find Near Me'** to use your browser's location

We have markets across Greenfield, Lakeview, Northside, Downtown, Eastside, Westside and Southside!

🕐 You can check which markets are open right now on our **'Open Right Now'** section on the home page! Our real-time clock compares current time with market schedules.

Here's a quick overview:
• **Riverside Farmers Market** — Saturday 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM
• **Lakeside Community Market** — Sunday 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM
• **Maple Street Market** — Wed & Sat 7:00 AM – 12:00 PM
• **Central City Farmers Market** — Tue, Thu & Sat 7:30 AM – 2:30 PM
• **Green Valley Market** — Fri & Sun 8:00 AM – 1:30 PM
• **Sunnyside Farm Market** — Sat & Sun 6:00 AM – 12:00 PM

🌸 Here's what's typically in season:

🌱 **Spring** — Leafy greens, radishes, asparagus, strawberries, fresh herbs

☀️ **Summer** — Tomatoes, berries, corn, cucumbers, peppers, stone fruit

🍂 **Autumn** — Pumpkins, apples, squash, root vegetables

❄️ **Winter** — Citrus fruits, broccoli, root vegetables, winter greens

Visit our Produce Guide to explore seasonal produce in detail!

🍅 Fresh tomatoes are a summer highlight at FreshFind markets!

You can find tomatoes at:
• **Riverside Farmers Market** (Sat 8 AM – 1 PM)
• **Central City Farmers Market** (Tue, Thu & Sat 7:30 AM – 2:30 PM)

Tomatoes are in season during **Summer**. Look for cherry, heirloom, beefsteak and roma varieties. Market tomatoes are picked ripe and are far superior in flavour!

🌱 Looking for organic produce? Here are our most organic-friendly markets:

✅ **Green Valley Market** — Entirely organic-certified
✅ **Meadow Lane Organic Market** — Certified organic
✅ **Riverside Farmers Market** — Many organic vendors
✅ **Central City Farmers Market** — Mix of organic & conventional

Tip: Look for the organic tag on market cards in our directory!

❤️ Bookmarking your favourite markets and produce is easy!

1️⃣ Click the **heart icon** on any market or produce card
2️⃣ View all your saved items in **Saved Items**
3️⃣ Add **personal notes** to each bookmark
4️⃣ **Export** your bookmarks as a file

Your bookmarks are saved in your browser session.

🌿 Fresh herbs are available at several markets!

• **Maple Street Market** — Wed & Sat, specialises in herbs
• **Green Valley Market** — Fri & Sun, organic herbs
• **Meadow Lane Organic Market** — Mon & Fri, certified organic

Common herbs available include basil, thyme, rosemary, parsley, coriander, chives and mint!

📍 FreshFind uses your browser's location feature to help find nearby markets!

To use location:
1️⃣ Click **'Find Near Me'** button
2️⃣ Allow location permission when prompted
3️⃣ Markets will be sorted by proximity

If you prefer not to share location, simply search by area name in the Market Directory.
